collection.description: Large striped shapes glimpsed in the foliage convince a child that a tiger lives on Isola.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: Large striped shapes are glimpsed through distant foliage. A child insists a tiger lives on Isola.

choices.label: Ask whether the sighting was mistaken

a.name: Answer A
a.text: Tracks suggest an animal, but the size is disputed.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: Paths are marked and children travel with companions.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: Some accept an ordinary explanation; others remain unconvinced.

d.name: Answer D
d.text: A festival mask appears, and future sightings become even harder to evaluate.
